name: Lalena (Jazz Minor)
description: Functional jazzy minor: an i-v pendulum, a iv-bVII7-bIII cell that tonicizes the relative major, and a real V7 turnaround back to i. In Am it is the Lalena record (Am-Em-Dm-G7-C-E7).
source: Donovan + Mickie Most (1966-69), via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets, from Lalena
